title: A Locker for the Group Chat
author: Elodie Fairweather
blurb: Bram Amberdale, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
